playoff.note: Two two-legged ties for the last two Botola Pro places; away goals decide if level.

notes: Botola Pro: 16 clubs, 30 rounds, one August-May season. Relegation: 15th and 16th down direct, 13th and 14th into two-legged ties against the Botola 2 3rd and 4th; Botola 2 promotes its top two directly, so four places change each way. Botola 2 (16 clubs) is not in our list, so MAR1 is closed_down in our data even though the real route exists. 2025-26 needed the ties: UTS Rabat survived and Olympique Dcheira went down, alongside US Yacoub El Mansour and Olympic Safi.
